resources.name: Crystal structure of α-4T/LT (Siegrist et al., Adv. Mater. 1998)

access.notes: Unit cell parameters are given in the paper; atomic coordinates may be obtained from the CSD or the authors.

resources.notes: Contains the unit cell (monoclinic, P21/c, a=6.09 Å, b=7.86 Å, c=30.48 Å, β=91.8°) and atomic fractional coordinates.

resources.name: TINKER molecular modeling package (version 4.1 or later)

access.notes: Open-source molecular mechanics software; also available via GitHub (https://github.com/TinkerTools/tinker).

resources.name: Modified MM3 force field for 4T

access.notes: Derivable from the original MM3 parameters (Allinger et al.) with published modifications: an ab initio inter-ring torsion potential (Raos et al., Chem. Phys. Lett. 379, 364 (2003)), potential-derived charges from B3LYP/6-31G**, and a rescaling of R⁻⁶ dispersion terms (Marcon & Raos, J. Phys. Chem. B 108, 18053 (2004)). May be available in TINKER distribution or from the authors.

resources.notes: The agent must implement these modifications based on the literature descriptions.

resources.name: Vapor pressure data of 4T (Kloc & Laudise, J. Cryst. Growth 1998)

access.notes: Published in a journal article; the data (vapor pressure vs. temperature) can be extracted from the paper (Table 1 and Figure 5).

resources.notes: Needed to compute deposition rates via the Knudsen equation.
